info.long_name: Patients with a Lyme Disease Diagnosis
info.short_description: Monthly count of patients with a Lyme disease diagnosis.
info.long_description: Monthly count of patients with a Lyme disease diagnosis, per Epic's "Lyme N" measure. Data from Epic Cosmos, which contains de-identified data from 300M+ patients across 1,600+ hospitals. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic (reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and imputed as 5; see epic_lyme_suppressed_flag. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2852889: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America, Has Any Encounters - the denominator (epic_n_patients) is all patients with any encounter, not restricted to any diagnosis or encounter type otherwise.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} patients had a Lyme disease diagnosis.

info.long_name: Percent of Patients with a Lyme Disease Diagnosis
info.short_description: Monthly percent of patients with a Lyme disease diagnosis.
info.long_description: Monthly percentage of patients with a Lyme disease diagnosis, computed as epic_n_lyme / epic_n_patients * 100 - a percent of all patients, NOT a rate per 100,000. Where the numerator was suppressed it is imputed as 5 before the percentage is computed. Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing, because dividing by the imputed denominator of 5 would assert a meaningless value; those cells are marked by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2852889.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients had a Lyme disease diagnosis.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the Lyme disease numerator (count and percent)
info.short_description: Indicates whether the Lyme disease numerator was suppressed and imputed; applies to both epic_n_lyme and epic_pct_lyme.
info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the Lyme disease cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and epic_n_lyme was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. The flag is computed before imputation, so it records what the source withheld rather than what the ingest wrote. It covers epic_pct_lyme as well, because the percentage is derived from this same numerator cell. Suppression of the denominator is tracked separately by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
